semantics: Preserve the parent ordinary full-layer traversal and its head3.0 extra immediately after layer3; all MLP counts remain1. In layer4, deleted heads contribute zero including their Q/K/V biases without editing any stored tensors; shared attention output bias remains once. Deletion changes the initial attention delta and therefore the inputs to recomputed head4.3; the new feedback path is not a linear subtraction or a predicted gain. This trial preserves the useful post-layer3 head3.0 placement and measures the interaction directly.
